```{r}
library(BiocCitation)
use_citation(doi = '10.1038/nmeth.3252', output = "CITATION")
use_citation(
    doi = c("10.1186/s12859-016-1323-z", "10.1093/bioinformatics/btaa687"), 
    output = "CITATION2"  
)
```
